source_text.body:
Build a staffing marketplace MVP and a browser game
Replit Agent built a staffing marketplace MVP in 30 minutes, then helped create the game Dodge the Diplomacy with zones, unlockable characters, and boss fights.
·
May 4, 2026
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
During Replit’s free Agent birthday event, the poster first used Replit Agent to build an MVP for a staffing marketplace in 30 minutes. They then iterated on a browser game by feeding the agent new feature ideas one after another, and the agent implemented them, resulting in mechanics like different projectile zones, unlockable satirical characters, death quotes, and boss fights; the human’s role was supplying ideas and testing.
How it went
The game shipped as Dodge the Diplomacy with 6 zones and 7 unlockable characters, and the poster says it was built entirely with Replit Agent despite having zero prior game-development experience. The thread gives no performance metrics or detailed limits beyond asking others to try it.
Worth knowing
The clearest practical takeaway is speed: the staffing marketplace MVP was done in 30 minutes during the event.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
Build an MVP of a [marketplace type, e.g. staffing] marketplace where [user type A] can post [listings/jobs] and [user type B] can browse and apply. Include sign-up, a listing page, and a simple dashboard for each side. When it's running, tell me what's built and what's still missing, then suggest three next features.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/replit/comments/1t3fdq3/thank_you_replit_i_created_a_game
